Messages.Author: Teeka
Messages.Body:
Some q's from a newbie:

1. Can a vampire's special abilities that don't require the vampire to
take an action(like Alexandra's ability to untap another Toreador or
Klaus van der Veken's ability to cancel a hunting ground) be used
while that vampire is in torpor? Or does he/she have to be ready?
2. Can the effects of cards like Blood Doll be used if the vampire it
is played on is in torpor?
3. Is it true that a card only uses your one master phase action if it
explicitly states "use a master phase action to...", so for example I
could suck a blood out of 4 separate Blood Dolls in one master phase?
4. If this is the case, does this mean I can play a master card and
then use its effect immediately afterwards (in the same master phase)?
Again Blood Doll: I play it, then I suck one blood to my pool in the
same master phase.
5. In the errata page, it says Hunting Grounds are now type 'hunting
ground'. Does this mean they're Master cards, type location: hunting
ground, or type master: hunting ground (no location)?
thanks for helping us out!
Teeka

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Teeka wrote:
> Some q's from a newbie:
>
> 1. Can a vampire's special abilities that don't require the vampire to
> take an action(like Alexandra's ability to untap another Toreador or
> Klaus van der Veken's ability to cancel a hunting ground) be used
> while that vampire is in torpor? Or does he/she have to be ready?

If the effect doesn't specify that the vampire must be ready, then the
vampire need not be ready.

> 2. Can the effects of cards like Blood Doll be used if the vampire it
> is played on is in torpor?

Yes, as above.

> 3. Is it true that a card only uses your one master phase action if it
> explicitly states "use a master phase action to...", so for example I
> could suck a blood out of 4 separate Blood Dolls in one master phase?

Yes.

> 4. If this is the case, does this mean I can play a master card and
> then use its effect immediately afterwards (in the same master phase)?
> Again Blood Doll: I play it, then I suck one blood to my pool in the
> same master phase.

Yes.

> 5. In the errata page, it says Hunting Grounds are now type 'hunting
> ground'. Does this mean they're Master cards, type location: hunting
> ground, or type master: hunting ground (no location)?

Locations. See online card list.
